name: WF1 - WhatsApp AI Agent (Gemini + Brand Flow)

parameters.query:
WITH client_to_update AS (
  SELECT client_id 
  FROM leads 
  WHERE id = {{ $json.lead_id }}
),
fallback_token AS (
  SELECT wa_access_token, phone_number_id 
  FROM clients 
  WHERE wa_access_token IS NOT NULL 
    AND wa_access_token <> '' 
    AND phone_number_id IS NOT NULL 
    AND phone_number_id <> ''
  LIMIT 1
),
updated_client AS (
  UPDATE clients
  SET wa_access_token = COALESCE(clients.wa_access_token, (SELECT wa_access_token FROM fallback_token)),
      phone_number_id = COALESCE(clients.phone_number_id, (SELECT phone_number_id FROM fallback_token))
  WHERE id = (SELECT client_id FROM client_to_update)
    AND (wa_access_token IS NULL OR wa_access_token = '' OR phone_number_id IS NULL OR phone_number_id = '')
  RETURNING *
),
current_client AS (
  SELECT * FROM updated_client
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM clients 
  WHERE id = (SELECT client_id FROM client_to_update)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated_client)
)
SELECT l.id, l.name, l.phone, l.score, l.status, l.interest, l.flow_step,
       c.name as brand_name,
       COALESCE(c.wa_access_token, (SELECT wa_access_token FROM fallback_token)) as wa_access_token,
       COALESCE(c.phone_number_id, (SELECT phone_number_id FROM fallback_token)) as brand_phone_number_id,
       COALESCE(l.flow_step, 'welcome') as current_flow_step,
       bd_prompt.content as system_prompt
FROM leads l
LEFT JOIN current_client c ON l.client_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN brain_docs bd_prompt ON bd_prompt.client_id = (SELECT id FROM clients WHERE name = 'ABM Groups' LIMIT 1) AND bd_prompt.doc_type = 'prompt'
WHERE l.id = {{ $json.lead_id }}

SELECT m.direction, m.content as message, m.sent_at
FROM messages m
JOIN conversations cv ON m.conversation_id = cv.id
WHERE cv.lead_id = {{ $('Extract Data').first().json.lead_id }}
ORDER BY m.sent_at DESC LIMIT 12
UPDATE leads SET score = $1, status = $2, flow_step = $3, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $4

INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, tenant_id, direction, content, is_ai, sent_at, msg_type, status)
SELECT cv.id, cv.tenant_id, 'outbound', $1, true, NOW(), 'text', 'sent'
FROM conversations cv
WHERE cv.lead_id = $2
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, tenant_id, direction, content, is_ai, sent_at, msg_type, status) SELECT cv.id, cv.tenant_id, 'inbound', $1, false, NOW(), 'text', 'received' FROM conversations cv WHERE cv.lead_id = $2 LIMIT 1;
